generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work experience: The bidder should have executed at least single works of Comprehensive AMC of Xerox machines costing not less than Rs.1.605 Lakhs in a single contract as a prime contractor in any reputed organization during the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (weightage of 10% per year shall be given to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited). Copies of Work Order and corresponding Work Completion certificate issued by the organization (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be enclosed as documentary proof.

The bidder shall not have been subjected to forfeiture of EMD/ foreclosure/termination of their Contract in KPCL or Government or any other utility or shall not have been blacklisted for participating in tender by KPCL or Government or any other utility in India during the past five years. Bidder shall furnish the declaration in this regard as specified in Annexure-VII of Tender Document.
Independent PF code registration certificate / Annexure-X

Qualification: The bidder should have an average annual financial turnover of Rs.3.21 Lakhs in any two financial years from the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of annual turnover certificate/ profit & loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2026-27).
